description: Velsao beach offers magnificent views of the sunrise and sunset. The seashore can be absolutely empty and free from tourists. It's a beautiful beach enclosed with thick coconut trees that line the coastal road and the large part of the seashore. Its calm and quiet atmosphere will simply let you hear the murmuring of birds very clearly. While being here, you'll get a lovely long stretch of white sand that is perfect for relaxation, strolling, and sunbathing. The soothing air, cool breezes, and the water of the beach simply create a perfect picturesque view. VELSAO BEACH LOCATION Beach Velsao It is located on Goa's southern coast and links to the Bogmalo and Majorda and Colva beaches to the north and south, respectively. Velsao Beach is in the Indian state of Goa. It is located around 25 kilometers south of Panaji, the state capital. The beach is recognized for its tranquil and less congested ambiance when compared to other of North Goa's more prominent beaches. Velsao Beach is well-known for its golden beaches and calm waves, making it a reasonably pleasant destination for those looking for a relaxing beach experience. You may get to Velsao Beach via a variety of kinds of transportation, including taxis, rental cars, and local buses. Velsao Beach is amazingly gorgeous and happens to be one of the most stunning beaches in Goa. The best time to visit this beach is from November to March. It is perfect for honeymoon couples to spend a romantic weekend holiday. One can relax, unwind and refresh here in the lap of nature. Just like other beaches, all kinds of water sports activities are available for adventure freaks. There are some budget hotels and guest houses, which are located nearby Velsao, and that too at affordable costs. After sunset, Velsao just doesn't cool down, but also begins to heat up with people of all ages making this place a throbbing nightlife. There are some bars and hyper-hip discos nearby Velsao, which are of famous hangout spots for tourists. Beach offers a superb view of the sunrise and sunset, so make sure to be here at the time of dawn and dusk. Some of the popular tourist attractions around Velsao beach are Velsao Chruch, The Chapel of Three Kings, Our Lady of Cures Chapel. NAVIGATING TO THE ENCHANTING VELSAO BEACH: YOUR TRAVEL GUIDE Embark on a delightful journey to the captivating Velsao Beach in Goa, easily accessible through various transportation options, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience. 1. AUTO RICKSHAW: SWIFT AND CONVENIENT Auto rickshaws are a readily available and convenient mode of transport in Goa. You can easily find them at the airport, railway station, and various locations across the city. With reasonable fares, auto rickshaws provide a hassle-free ride to Velsao Beach. 2. BY AIR: AERIAL ESCAPE If you choose air travel, Goa International Airport (GOI), Dabolim, is the gateway to your Velsao Beach adventure. Located 29 kilometers from Panaji, the airport is a mere 47.3 kilometers away from Velsao Beach. Upon arrival, you can opt for a taxi, auto rickshaw, or even rent a bike or scooty for an invigorating ride to the beach. The journey from the airport to Velsao Beach takes around 21 minutes, allowing you to relish the scenic drive. 3. BY ROAD: SCENIC ROUTES AWAIT Travelling by road offers several options, including buses and cabs. Commence your journey from Vasco Da Gama, Goa, for a convenient starting point. Covering a distance of approximately 15 kilometers in about 20 minutes, you can easily reach Velsao Beach. Alternatively, you can rent bikes or utilize state buses for a flexible and enjoyable ride. 4. BY RAIL: RAILS TO SHORE Rail travel provides accessible options as well. The nearest railway station to Velsao Beach is Vasco Da Gama, just 8 kilometers away. With well-connected routes to major cities, this railway station offers easy access. Madgaon is another nearby option, located around 17.4 kilometers from Velsao Beach and reachable within approximately 30 minutes. Upon reaching your chosen station, taxis and bike rentals are available for a convenient transition to the beach. 5. FROM PANJIM (CAPITAL OF GOA): SWIFT CONNECTIONS The journey from Panjim to Velsao Beach is easily facilitated by road transportation. Covering a distance of around 24.8 kilometers, the drive takes approximately 29 minutes. Choose from cabs, bike rentals, or auto-rickshaws, ensuring swift access to the mesmerizing Velsao Beach. With these diverse transportation options at your disposal, your visit to the enchanting Velsao Beach promises relaxation, exploration, and cherished memories.
